questions.question:
Study the following information carefully and answer the questions accordingly.

 

Eight persons – A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H were born on January, March, April, June, September, October, November and December in the same year but not necessarily in the same order. G was born before the person who was born in June month. Two persons were born between G and D who was born in the month which has 30 days. F was born just after the month when B was born and just before H. One person was born between C and A. E was born just after the month when A was born.

 

Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence they form a group. Which one of the following does not belong to that group?
questions.explanation:
From the given statements, G was born before the person who was born in June month. Two persons were born between G and D who was born in the month which has 30 days. Here we have two possibilities i.e., Case 1 and Case 2.


F was born just after the month when B was born and just before H. Now, one more possibility added here i.e., Case 1a.



One person was born between C and A. Here Case 1 is ruled out now. E was born just after the month when A was born. Here Case 1a is also ruled out. So, the final arrangement is such as-

Except F, all of them were born in the month having 31 days.

2) The number of items between Oregano and Cinnamon is the same as the number of items between Pepper and Coriander when counted from the left of Cinnamon and Pepper. One item is placed between Coriander and Turmeric, which is not placed adjacent to Oregano.

3) Fennel was placed to the immediate left of Jeera. Hence, case 1 gets eliminated.

Final arrangement will be:-

According to the common solution we can say that Oregano is second right with respect to Basil.

Hence, the correct answer is option E.

questions.question:
Study the following information carefully and answer accordingly.

 

Seven events A, B, C, D, E, F and G are held on different days of same week from Monday to Sunday but not necessarily in the same order. Events, which start with a vowel, are held in India.
G is held two days after D. C is held before D but not immediately before D. F is held immediately before B. D is held on neither Tuesday nor Friday. Events held in India are not held on Sunday. E is held after A.

 

E is held on which day?
questions.explanation:
Starting Point: First try to place G and D to have least number of cases.

Clues:

1. G is held two days after D.

2. D is held on neither Tuesday nor Friday.

Inference:

From clue 1 and clue 2, G is held on Wednesday or Friday or Saturday.

Clues:

3. C is held before D but not immediately before D.

4. F is held immediately before B.

Inference:

From clue 3, case I is rejected as C can’t be placed. And thus, C is held on Monday or Tuesday.

From clue 4, F is held on Tuesday or Saturday.

Clues:

5. Events held in India are not held on Sunday.

6. E is held after A.

Inference:

From clue 5, case III is rejected as A and E can’t be placed.

From clue 6, A is held on Tuesday, E is held on Thursday.

The final table is given below:

E is held on Thursday.

questions.question: In pipe X a tank can fill in 5 minutes and another tank Y can empty the tank in 10 minutes. In how many minutes will the tank be filled ¾ parts when both pipes are opened and the tank already filled ½ part?
questions.explanation:
If pipe X can fill the tank in 5 minutes, it means that it fills 1/5th of the tank in one minute.

Y empties the

tank in 10 minutes. Therefore, it empties 1/10th of the tank in one minute.

Therefore,

net rate of filling the tank \(= \frac{1}{5}\  - \ \frac{1}{10}\  = \ \frac{1}{10}\)

Time taken to fill 1/2th of tank \(= \ \frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{1}{10}} = \ 5\ mins\)

amount of the tank that needs to be filled \(= \frac{3}{4}\  - \ \frac{1}{2} = \ \frac{1}{4}\)

The time taken to fill 1/4th of the tank\(= \frac{\frac{1}{4}}{\frac{1}{10}} = \ 2.5\ minutes\)

Therefore,

tank will be filled to 3/4th of its capacity\(\  = \ 5\ mins\  + \ 2.5\ mins = \ 7.5\ mins\)

questions.question: The interest on a sum of money of Rs.20000 at 6% per annum for x years is Rs. 6000, find the compound interest on the same sum for the (x-3) years at the same rate.
questions.explanation:
Simple Interest\(= \frac{(P\  \times \text{r } \times \ t)}{100}\)

\(= > 6000 = \ 20000 \times 6 \times \frac{x}{100}\)

\(= > x = \ 5\ years\)

Now,

\(t = \ x - 3\  = \ 2\ \)

Compound Interest \(= \ P\ \{(1\  + \ \frac{r}{100})^{t} - 1\}\)

\(= 20000\lbrack(1 + \frac{6}{100})^{2} - 1\rbrack\)

\(= 20000\lbrack(\frac{53}{50})^{2} - 1\rbrack\)

\(= \ Rs\ 2472\)

questions.question: A man covers 1100 km by bus and train. He cover \(\frac{2}{5}\)th of the distance by bus and the remaining by train. If the ratio of the speed of the bus and the speed of the train 1 : 3. And the speed of bus is 40 kmph. Then, find the total time taken?
questions.explanation:
Speed of bus = 40 kmph

Here, the ratio of speed of bus and train is 1 : 3.

Then, the speed of train = 40 x 3 = 120 kmph

\(\frac{2}{5}\) th of the distance = \(\frac{2}{5}\) x 1100 = 440 km

T = \(\frac{440}{40}\) = 11 hours

Remaining distance = 1100 – 440 = 660 km

660 km distance cover by train

T = \(\frac{660}{120}\) = 5.5 hours

Total time taken = 11 +5.5 = 16.5 hours

questions.question: A man can row at a speed of 12 km/hr in still water to a certain upstream point and back to the starting point in a river which flows at 3 km/hr. Find his average speed for the total journey.

Let the distance traveled be d km.

Downstream speed \(= \ 12 + 3\  = \ 15\ kmph\)

Upstream speed =\(\ 12\  - 3\  = \ 9\ kmph\)

Average speed\(\  = \ \frac{(d + d)}{\lbrack\frac{d}{15} + \frac{d}{9}\rbrack}\)

\(= \frac{(2 \times 135)}{24}\)

\(= \frac{270}{24} = \ 11(\frac{1}{4})\ kmph\)
